# chameleon_table_grants (Data Source)

List all access grants configured on a catalog, namespace, or table.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Grants on a specific table.
data "chameleon_table_grants" "events_acl" {
  catalog   = "analytics"
  namespace = "raw"
  table     = "events"
}

# Grants on the namespace itself (omit `table`).
data "chameleon_table_grants" "raw_acl" {
  catalog   = "analytics"
  namespace = "raw"
}

output "events_grants" {
  value = data.chameleon_table_grants.events_acl.grants
}
```
